name: UK climate-related financial disclosures (Companies Act TCFD)
description: Mandatory climate disclosures for large UK companies, already in force.
data_required: Scope 1-3 emissions, targets, transition plan, governance
in_scope_reason: UK parent exceeds the large-company thresholds

name: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (ESRS)
description: Double-materiality reporting under ESRS for large EU entities, with limited assurance.
data_required: Scope 3 by category with primary-data share, energy mix, targets, value-chain metrics
in_scope_reason: EU subsidiaries (Venlo, Lodz, Frankfurt DCs) exceed size thresholds

name: UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (ISSB-based)
description: ISSB S1/S2-based UK standards expected to replace TCFD-style reporting.
data_required: Scope 1-3, scenario analysis, financed impacts, industry metrics

name: EU Green Claims Directive
description: Substantiation and verification of environmental claims before use.
in_scope_reason: We market products with environmental claims into the EU

name: Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive
description: Value-chain due diligence for very large EU companies.
in_scope_reason: Below the EU turnover and employee thresholds

name: California Climate Corporate Data Accountability Act
description: Scope 1-3 reporting for large companies doing business in California.
in_scope_reason: No California operations; US DC is in Ohio
